properties.name: A skill is reachable from a description of the job, in the words a person would use
properties.statement: Promoted 2026-09-20 on Anthony's word. flo2 F8: 'the only way to find a skill you cannot name is to read all 29 descriptions', and the owner's own line, 'I continually forget which skills are available.' BUILT in v0.65.0 as `find_skills`, with a held-out corpus of one query per skill and the same rank-first ratchet the tools have: 30 of 30 in the top five, 25 of 30 first.
